title: Loft conversions
summary: Turn unused loft space into a bedroom, office or playroom and add real value to your home.
intro: Your loft could be the extra bedroom, home office or playroom you've been looking for, often without needing planning permission.
body:
## Is my loft suitable?

We'll check head height, roof structure and stair access on a free visit and tell you honestly what's possible.

## Conversion types

- **Velux / rooflight conversions**: the most affordable option, keeping the roof line
- **Dormer conversions**: extra head height and floor space
- **Hip-to-gable conversions**: ideal for semi-detached and end-terrace homes

Every conversion includes structural work, insulation, stairs, electrics, plastering and fire safety to meet building regulations.
